name: doska/symfony
description: Dev-only toolbar that turns a clicked element into a Symfony-aware prompt: controller, Twig file and line, and UX component.

suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: Names Twig components in the copied prompt.
suggest.symfony/ux-live-component: Adds Live Component name and props to the copied prompt.
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: Adds Stimulus controller names to the copied prompt.
suggest.symfony/ux-turbo: Adds the surrounding Turbo frame to the copied prompt.
